cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include("cmake/cmkr.cmake" OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cmake.toml)
endif()

# Variables
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH cmake)

# vcpkg settings
set(VCPKG_OVERLAY_PORTS
	"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vcpkg-overlay"
)
set(VCPKG_OVERLAY_TRIPLETS
	"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vcpkg-overlay"
)
project(invivo-cbct
	LANGUAGES
		C
	VERSION
		1.0.0
)

if(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT AND NOT CMKR_DISABLE_VCPKG)
	include(FetchContent)
	# Fix warnings about DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP
	if(POLICY CMP0135)
		cmake_policy(SET CMP0135 NEW)
	endif()
	message(STATUS "Fetching vcpkg (2025.06.13)...")
	FetchContent_Declare(vcpkg
		URL
			"https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/archive/refs/tags/2025.06.13.tar.gz"
		SUBBUILD_DIR
			"CMakeFiles/vcpkg-subbuild"
		SOURCE_DIR
			vcpkg
		BINARY_DIR
			"CMakeFiles/vcpkg-build"
	)
	FetchContent_MakeAvailable(vcpkg)

	if(CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL Darwin AND CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL "")
		set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES ${CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR} CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
	endif()
	include("${vcpkg_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake")
endif()

# Packages
find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED CONFIG)

find_package(JasPer REQUIRED)

find_package(PThreads4W REQUIRED)

find_package(Stb REQUIRED)

# Target: invivo-cbct
set(invivo-cbct_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
	"src/base64/base64.c"
	"src/common.c"
	"src/inv.c"
	"src/main.c"
	"src/palette.c"
	"src/stb_image/stb_image.c"
	"src/viewer.c"
)

add_executable(invivo-cbct)

target_sources(invivo-cbct PRIVATE ${invivo-cbct_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${invivo-cbct_SOURCES})

target_compile_definitions(invivo-cbct PRIVATE
	WANT_THREADS
	"$<$<C_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS>"
)

target_compile_features(invivo-cbct PRIVATE
	c_std_99
)

target_compile_options(invivo-cbct PRIVATE
	"$<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang>:-Wall>"
	"$<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang>:-Wextra>"
	"$<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang>:-pedantic>"
	"$<$<AND:$<CONFIG:Release>,$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang>>:-Ofast>"
)

target_include_directories(invivo-cbct PRIVATE
	"src/base64"
	${Stb_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

target_link_libraries(invivo-cbct PRIVATE
	"$<IF:$<TARGET_EXISTS:SDL2::SDL2>,SDL2::SDL2,SDL2::SDL2-static>"
	JasPer::jasper
	PThreads4W::PThreads4W
	"$<$<NOT:$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>>:m>"
)

target_link_options(invivo-cbct PRIVATE
	"$<$<AND:$<CONFIG:Release>,$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang>>:-s>"
)

get_directory_property(CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} DEFINITION VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
if(NOT CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
	set_property(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT invivo-cbct)
